rules.title: How it works
rules.p1: Tap any cell. What it turns into depends only on its neighbors: the up to 8 cells around it, diagonals included. Cells at the edge have fewer.
rules.p2: What counts is which neighbors the cell has and how many of each. What the tapped cell shows right now does not matter.
rules.p3: Sometimes a tap does nothing. Only taps that change a cell count as moves.
rules.p4: Within a game the rules never change: the same neighbors always give the same result. Find out what they are!
